question: Who completed the construction of the Qutub Minar?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Firoz Shah Tuglak.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Qutab-ud-din Aibak**, the first Muslim ruler of Delhi, begin the construction of the** Qutab Minar in 1200 AD.**
 
• But could only finish the **basement. **
 
• His successor,** Iltutmush, added three more storeys,** and in 1368.
 
• **Firoz Shah Tughlak** constructed the fifth and the last storey and **completed the construction of the Qutub Minar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffefc858b634f772fc72a8b1bd14e824e5982a4bd34767cb3c676eddad4934db.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The tomb of Khan Jahan at Bagerhat and the tomb of an Allama at Hazrat Pandua** were erected during Nasir-ud-Din Muhammad's time. ​
 
• **Muhi al-Din Muhammad** commonly known as Aurangzeb, who built the **Badshahi Mosque, Bibi Ka Maqbara, Moti Masjid** etc.
 
• The most important **monuments of** Qutub-ud-Din Aibak were.** Alai Darwaza,** Qutub** Minar**.
